options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns that the number of lanes is decreasing. Traffic must merge to the left.

questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must merge left.

options.text: Check for vehicles only in the direction that you plan on going, then proceed.
Let all vehicles that arrive before or after you go first.
Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check for traffic in all directions before proceeding.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, come to a complete stop and look all around before proceeding.

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
No trucks are allowed on the upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down and be ready to control your speed and brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right first, then left. Reduce your speed to handle the curves safely.

options.text: Sharp turn to the right ahead.
Upcoming sharp left and right turns.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign warns of a winding road ahead. Adjust your speed accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks where passing is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let cross traffic pass before proceeding.
questions.explanation: This sign means you must slow down or stop to let other vehicles and pedestrians pass first before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Begin to slow down.

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road or entrance. Do not proceed in the direction of this sign—traffic flows the opposite way. Turn around if you see this sign ahead.

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign indicates sharp turns ahead—first to the right, then to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates or disabled parking placards.

Unless it seems safe to do so.

questions.explanation: White rectangular signs show rules you must follow. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles for any reason.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: These signs tell you traffic laws you must follow. When you see this sign, drive in the direction the arrow points.

options.text: School zone or school crossing sign.

questions.correctAnswerText: School zone or school crossing sign.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs alert drivers to school zones. They warn that children or other pedestrians may be crossing the road nearby.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A reflective orange triangle on a vehicle means it travels slowly. You may see it on farm equipment, work vehicles, or horse-drawn wagons. It appears orange during the day and red at night.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means "stop."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a divided highway is beginning. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement can cause you to lose control. Slow down when you see it because it takes longer to stop on wet roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed. You will see it at intersections where making a U-turn would be unsafe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular red and white sign means you must yield the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic merging from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for traffic merging from the right.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that traffic may merge into your lane from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
Always come to a complete stop.
Activate your turn signal and proceed into traffic at the usual speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield to traffic on the main road when merging.
questions.explanation: A yield sign tells you to slow down and let other vehicles pass before entering the intersection. You don't have to stop if no vehicles are coming, but always slow down and be cautious.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about upcoming hazards. Round signs are used only to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to immediate hazards. This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane from the right.
